---
title: "RemoteFile"
---

## Usage

```typescript
const composio = new Composio({ apiKey: 'your-api-key' });
const result = await composio.remoteFile.list();
```

## Usage with the import

```typescript
import { Composio } from '@composio/core';

const composio = new Composio({ apiKey: 'your-api-key' });
const result = await composio.remoteFile.list();
```
